overview: We add a chat helper to your website or store that answers the questions you get every week, such as shipping times, sizing, opening hours and how to book. It learns only from the pages and documents you give us, so it does not make up policies. When it is unsure, it says so and offers your contact form or email. You test it first, then we switch it on.

faq: We set it to answer only from the content you provide and to say it does not know when the answer is missing. We test with tricky questions first, though no chat tool can promise it is never wrong.
Which websites does it work on?
Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow and most custom sites. Tell us your platform in the order form and we confirm the install method.
Do I pay for the chat tool myself?
Usually yes. The chat platform bills you directly, and some have a free starting plan. We suggest an option that fits your visitor numbers before we begin.
Can I edit the answers later?
Yes. We hand over a simple sheet or page where you change answers yourself, plus a short guide. Larger changes can be quoted as a small follow-up job.
